raw_text: Our analysis of the Zelenskyy surrender video confirms it is a deepfake produced using face-swap technology. Key indicators include: inconsistent skin texture around the neck-face boundary, unnatural eye blinking patterns, and audio that was likely generated by a text-to-speech model trained on Zelenskyy's public addresses. The video resolution was deliberately reduced to mask these artifacts.
